thread:
Alex W: kicking off quiet window, starting terraform apply for the us-west-2 infra delta. preflight passed but leaving strict monitoring on. tagging @SRE Lead and @Ops Oncall.
Maria P: links — PR: https://git.internal/repo/pr/789, change diff: https://git.internal/repo/changes/422, tfplan: https://ci.internal/plan/422. added short release-note blurb.
Deploybot: ⚙️ queued terraform apply #422 by Alex W (workspace=prod-usw2). expected 8m. will stream events.
Raj K: FYI this creates an analytics-service IAM role behind a gate. if any downstream jobs depend on old role names, hold off testing.
SRE Lead: Canary policy: start 10% for 15m. thresholds: error-rate >2% or P95 +150ms => rollback. Notify ops if either breaches.
Alex W: pinning provider (hash pinned to v3.2.1) to prevent drift during rollout. committing now.
Maria P: commit is pushed. I used tfvar `create_analytics_role = true` so we can toggle if needed.
Alex W: running apply:
```
terraform apply -auto-approve -target=module.network -var-file=prod-usw2.tfvars
```
Ops Oncall: if apply stalls or plan diverges, abort and run `deploybot rollback --apply-id 422`. open #incidents if rollback invoked.
Deploybot: apply started (id=422). logs: https://ci.internal/logs/422. ETA ~7m.
Raj K: seeing the iam binding in plan output, looks good. no conflicting policies detected. :thumbsup:
SRE Lead: first 5m of canary OK. moving to 50% traffic for 30m as staged ramp.
Maria P: updated release notes with rollback steps and provider pin info. changelog: "pin provider v3.2.1; add analytics-service IAM role behind gate"
Alex W: apply finished; outputs show new subnets + role ARN. marking canary active.
SRE Lead: metrics stable at 50% for 10m; continuing to full ramp.
Ops Oncall: keeping rollback window open until EOD per change window policy in case downstream batch jobs need time. ping me to coordinate revert.
Alex W: thanks all — will close thread after full rollout and stability window.
